name: singlet_spatial_deconv_mapping_unmeasured_gene_imputation
title: Impute unmeasured genes for targeted spatial panels
description: Predicts expression of genes absent from a targeted or partial spatial panel by transferring values from a full-transcriptome scRNA-seq reference, fitted on the shared panel genes. Writes an imputed cells-or-spots by unmeasured-genes matrix, a held-out per-gene score table, and a predictive SD for probabilistic methods. The default method is tangram; spage is the heuristic comparator. Do not use it to correct dropouts in measured genes (use imputation.expression_denoising) or to place dissociated cells on template locations (use spatial-deconv-mapping.cell_to_location_mapping).

dataset.description: Spatial dataset handle. layers/counts holds panel genes only; obsm/spatial holds optional coordinates.

reference.description: Reference scRNA-seq handle with full-transcriptome layers/counts and the cell-type column named by evaluation.label_key.

method.description: Imputation method. tangram is the default; spage is the heuristic comparator; gimvi returns predictive SDs.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for initialisation, minibatch order and held-out fold order.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, peak memory, device and, for tangram, the dense mapping size, without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

evaluation.description: Held-out gene scoring and null baselines; scores are written to uns/unmeasured_imputation_loo.

cv_mode.description: Held-out scheme: leave-one-gene-out or 10-fold over panel genes.

label_key.description: Reference obs column with cell-type labels, used by the cell-type-mean null.

null_k.description: Random reference cells averaged by the random-coupling null.

spage.description: Options for method spage (principal-vector alignment and kNN weights).

n_pv.description: Principal vectors for alignment; 30 is the benchmark value, the SpaGE function has no default.

pv_cosine_cutoff.description: Keep principal-vector pairs whose cosine similarity exceeds this value.

k_neighbors.description: Reference neighbours for kernel weights; neighbours with cosine distance of at least 1 are dropped.

mode.description: Mapping mode; cells is the default and the mode used in the benchmarks.

learning_rate.description: Adam learning rate for the mapping optimiser.

density_prior.description: Spatial density prior; none disables the density term.

gimvi.description: Options for method gimvi (joint variational model over two datasets).

n_latent.description: Dimension of the shared latent space.

kappa.description: Weight of the adversarial modality-classifier loss.

seurat.description: Options for method seurat (reference anchor transfer).

dims.description: Dimensions 1 to dims used for anchors; the vignette value, not a package default.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/imputed_unmeasured. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_spatial, n_unmeasured, median_rho, mean_rho, undefined_genes, median_variance_ratio, null_gap, interval_coverage (probabilistic methods only).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
